caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a blue long-sleeved bodice, likely from a historical garment, centered on a cream-colored or light beige background. The bodice is illustrated in shades of blue, with darker shading to indicate folds and depth. The garment has a high, rounded neckline adorned with a ruffled trim, buttoned front closure with matching blue buttons, and a fitted, curved waist. Each sleeve is full and gathered at the shoulder, tapering into a closely fitted lower sleeve with a decorative cuff that ends in a ruffle edged with a light frill, possibly lace. The collar and the end of the sleeves have these ruffled trims. A second, smaller and less detailed line drawing of the same bodice, showing the back view, appears in the bottom left corner, enclosed in a lightly marked square. The smaller sketch includes basic outlines for the sleeves, back seams, and the ruffled trim without any color or shading.
title: Blouse
